newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-SABRES AGREE TO TERMS WITH RIGHT WING DIXON WARD.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-SABRES AGREE TO TERMS WITH RIGHT WING DIXON WARD.

text.p: The Buffalo Sabres will have right wing Dixon Ward back in uniform for the next few years after agreeing to terms on a multi-year contract with the Group II restricted free agent Tuesday.

Ward, who signed as a free agent with Buffalo in August 1995, recorded 13 goals and 32 assists in 79 games last season. He also had 36 penalty minutes and a plus-17 rating en route to being selected the team's Tim Horton Memorial Award winner, bestowed upon the unsung hero of the club.
"We are very pleased that Dixon will be continuing his career in a Sabres' uniform," said general manager Darcy Regier.

"He was certainly a contributing factor in the '96-97 success -- both the division title and the advancement to the second playoff round. We'll look forward to having his experience alongside of some of our younger players when training camp opens."
